description: Ask to send the account's transfer events to an HTTPS address: your own receiver, or a Slack or Microsoft Teams incoming webhook, which gets a readable message. The endpoint starts pending: it receives only test events, on a sample transfer, until the account owner confirms it on the website, and the owner is normally notified by email. The signing secret is returned once, here; deliveries carry Standard Webhooks headers signed with it. Only the account owner's API keys and connected apps can add endpoints.

events.description: The events to send. Defaults to all of them.

url.description: The full HTTPS address. It must use a domain name and the standard port.

name: create_webhook_endpoint

detail.description: Plain English to pass on to the person behind the request.

signing_secret.description: The secret that signs every delivery, starting whsec_. It is shown only now: store it in the receiver's secret settings.

title: Add a webhook endpoint
